note: The D1 falsifier mutation table (PLAN-01 chunk 7 / D1c). The first 18 rows are the D0 table (mutations-c00697f.json) copied verbatim — that file stays byte-identical; this is the same tree (mybodycorpai @ c00697f) re-probed with a binary built from the D1 tip. The last 3 rows target shapes that only exist post-D1: the dispatch-driven request count on NotificationsBell (D1b item 3 emits the click-fetch tests), a two-dep exit guard on the pinned tree (D1c item 5's per-dep legs — every pinned multi-dep guard is currently refused by name, so this row measures what the refusal cannot catch), and a variant option the cap cuts (D1c item 6 names it in a skip title — a named skip is disclosure, not a test). Same protocol: the suite is generated once from the UNMUTATED tree with the binary named in the falsifiers reading, and never regenerated between mutations.
